diagnostic_recipe: For each saved point: form R=sum_C r_C z_C z_C.T and X similarly; residual=Y-P@R.T-Q@X.T; L=mean(residual**2); J=K*L+.003*reference*number_of_retained_proper_supports. Score clades with max(r,x)>1e-9 against saved physical truth. Trace accepted event path indices, never nearest-loss matching. Oracle family=canonical(singletons + fullset + true proper clades); profile=independent_qp(train, family); r=profile.theta[:m],x=profile.theta[m:]; replay train and validation predictions only. The oracle is post-hoc, is never exported and never changes selection.
